| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| `base_currency` | `"USD"` |

---

## 3️⃣ Check your budget limit  
I’ll retrieve your current budget limit so I can compare it against the converted price.  
(If you don’t already have a limit set, I’ll let you know.)
